This Nexus can only be affected by effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses. Cores can only be placed on this Nexus via Core Charge or effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses, and cannot be moved from this Nexus except via effects that target Grandwalker Nexuses.

header.cleanBody:
[LV1][LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
(Once per turn, send three cores from this Nexus to the Void) Refresh a "Machine Beast" family Spirit you control. Also, when that's a "Ten Crown"/"God-King" family Spirit, during this turn, it is unaffected by opposing Spirit/Nexus effects.
